description: This file defines the SavingsSchedularInterestPosterTask class, which implements a callable task responsible for posting interest on savings accounts within a scheduled job context. It interacts with interest posting logic and manages thread-local context during execution.

classes.name: SavingsSchedularInterestPosterTask
classes.description: A task class implementing Callable<Void> that manages the posting of interest on savings accounts, including setting context and handling exceptions.

methods.name: call
methods.description: Executes the interest posting process within a managed thread-local context, handling exceptions specific to job execution.

methods.name: setSavingAccounts
methods.description: Sets the collection of savings accounts to be processed for interest posting.

methods.name: setBackdatedTxnsAllowedTill
methods.description: Configures whether backdated transactions are permitted for interest posting.
